relationships.history: The best charge nurse she's ever worked with. She lured her here with a job ad and a pot of jollof.
They send each other patients and never say who.
His mother and hers sat in the same pew in Houston's Third Ward. She has been told to check on him.
He wants to sell Riverdale Clinic to a hospital group. She wants it to stay a clinic people can walk into.

memories.info: Opened Riverdale Clinic's doors on a Monday and saw forty-one construction workers by Friday.

profile.tagline: Sees forty patients a day and remembers their mothers' names.

appearance.hair: short natural hair, tapered, with a silver streak at the front
appearance.style: a long white coat over a teal ankara-print dress, flat brown loafers, a stethoscope
appearance.jewelry: small gold hoops, a gold cross
appearance.silhouette: a tall woman in a white coat with a flash of teal print

profile.family_background: Born in Ibadan, raised in Houston's Alief by a pharmacist father and a mother who ran a church choir. Divorced, no children, three godchildren she spoils.
profile.education: B.S. Biology, Rice University; M.D., Baylor College of Medicine
goals: Keep Riverdale Clinic a walk-in clinic
A night clinic for the construction crews
ambitions: Riverdale Medical Center, on her terms
profile.social_preferences: Sunday service, Sunday lunch, and nothing else on Sunday.

secrets.truth: She sees patients who can't pay and logs them as follow-ups. Riverdale Health would fire her for it.

social_media.bio: Family medicine. Riverdale Clinic. Drink water.

life_history: Residency at Ben Taub, Houston's county hospital.
Ten years of emergency and family medicine.
Opened Riverdale Clinic the month the first crews arrived.
